prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your pet choices and progress are automatically saved to your account so you never lose your companion."]
1: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Right-click your pet to open controls, drag to move across your screen, or click to chat anytime.", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
2: ["Choose Your Companion Base Archetype", "Select the initial starter style for your new pet companion."]
3: []
4: ["Sign In to Preserve & Restore Your Pet", "Log in to safely back up your active companion or restore your existing pets instantly."]
5: ["Launch Pet to Desktop"]
6: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Upload a clear image of your pet to generate your unique custom companion.", "Use a clear, well-lit photo showing your pet facing forward for best rendering accuracy."]
7: ["Embark on Your Companion Journey", "Select how you would like to start creating your companion experience today."]
8: ["Bringing Your Companion to Life", "Your pet is being crafted. Please keep this window open while generation completes."]
9: ["Secure Your Companion Account", "Sign in to securely link your pet companion data and maintain persistence across restarts."]
